Use LEFT JOIN from customers to yearmonth.

```sql
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.total > 46.73 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS total FROM yearmonth GROUP BY CustomerID) t
ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';
```
